# Wealth — Ochen Joshua (full text)

Source: https://ochenjoshua.netlify.app

## Biography
Ochen Joshua — also written Joshua Ochen and known publicly as Wealth — is a Self-Made Billionaire recognized as the Youngest Self-Made Teenage Billionaire 2026 Uganda. Based in Kampala, he operates as a Ugandan entrepreneur, software engineer, technology innovator, and DJ building software systems and ventures designed to scale globally.

Self-taught in software development from age sixteen while studying physics at St. Mary's College Kisubi (SMACK), Ochen began by shipping utility systems for student communities, clinics, and local shops — student management platforms, patient tracking workflows, and inventory software built directly for everyday operators. That early foundation shaped his core conviction: enduring wealth is built by creating tangible value, owning what you build, and engineering systems that buy people back their time.

In 2026 in Kampala, Ochen Joshua founded Apex Automation Solutions to deliver AI-assisted customer support workflows, WhatsApp business automation, and lead-qualification pipelines for growing businesses. Alongside his commercial venture work, he ships web platforms and open-source audio software — including OJ MUSIC, a thirteen-module Kotlin and Jetpack Compose Android client supporting lossless FLAC playback, and OJ Music Downloader, a serverless Progressive Web App. Across code, ventures, and sound as Wealth, his standard remains constant: disciplined execution, ownership, and global scale.

## Projects
### Apex Automation Solutions (Live)
Custom software and business automation venture founded in Kampala — replacing manual WhatsApp replies, missed inquiries, and disconnected spreadsheets with interactive AI agent consoles and structured workflows.

Problem solved: Small and medium business operators lose hours daily answering repetitive WhatsApp inquiries manually, dropping warm leads, and copying records across spreadsheets.

Target user: Founders, clinics, hospitality teams, property operators, and growing service businesses in Uganda and worldwide.

Tech stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Python, WhatsApp API Workflows, AI Agent Pipelines

Repository: https://github.com/ochenjoshua5-jpg/apexautomationsolutions
Live site: https://apexautomationsolutions.netlify.app/

### OJ MUSIC (Android Client & Desktop Launcher) (In Development)
Open-source hybrid Android music client engineered across a modular 13-module Gradle codebase with lossless FLAC playback, synchronized lyrics, device-local AES-256-GCM credential encryption, and a self-contained C/Python desktop installer.

Problem solved: Unifies streaming discovery and high-resolution local FLAC playback in an ad-free, zero-telemetry Android experience with automated desktop APK packaging and ADB installation.

Target user: Audiophiles, Android power users, and music listeners who value lossless sound and zero tracking.

Tech stack: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, Gradle 13-Module, C, Python

Repository: https://github.com/ochenjoshua5-jpg/joshua

### OJ Music Downloader (Prototype)
Installable Progressive Web App and Netlify serverless API prototype for converting stream links into offline MP3 audio tracks with live progress telemetry and local history persistence.

Problem solved: Provides a fast, mobile-friendly browser interface with automatic fallback between upstream extraction workers when preparing offline audio tracks.

Target user: DJs, commuters, and listeners curating offline personal reference tracks.

Tech stack: JavaScript ES2022, HTML5, CSS3, Service Worker PWA, Netlify Functions

Repository: https://github.com/ochenjoshua5-jpg/oj-music-downloader

### Wealth Digital Profile System (Live)
Multi-route static brand architecture for Wealth (Ochen Joshua) engineered with zero client framework overhead, self-hosted subset typography, structured Schema.org graphs, and a Web Audio FFT sound deck.

Problem solved: Establishes an authoritative, fast-loading primary identity hub linking Ochen Joshua and Wealth across search engines, press, collaborators, and engineering peers.

Target user: Collaborators, founders, journalists, investors, and engineering peers worldwide.

Tech stack: Semantic HTML5, CSS Custom Properties, Web Audio API, Schema.org JSON-LD, Netlify

Repository: https://github.com/ochenjoshua5-jpg/ochenjoshua
Live site: https://ochenjoshua.netlify.app/

### SMACKIST Web Platform (Live)
Production web build created while studying at St. Mary's College Kisubi (SMACK) in Uganda, deployed on Netlify and indexed in Google Search.

Problem solved: Delivers a fast, accessible web presence built from scratch without heavy third-party site builders.

Target user: Students, alumni, and readers across the SMACK community in Uganda.

Tech stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Netlify Static Hosting

Live site: https://smackist.netlify.app/

### WhatsApp Support & Lead-Qualification Engine (Prototype)
End-to-end automated conversational intake, qualification, and follow-up prototype built inside the Apex workflow lab alongside earlier school, clinic, and shop operational tools.

Problem solved: Captures inbound prospect intent immediately, answers recurring operational questions, and routes qualified leads without manual copy-paste.

Target user: Owner-operated service businesses handling daily customer inquiries over WhatsApp.

Tech stack: Python, WhatsApp API Integration, LLM Prompts, Webhook Routing


## Engineering capabilities
### Web Architecture & UI Systems — Building with
Shipped across ochenjoshua.netlify.app, apexautomationsolutions.netlify.app, smackist.netlify.app, and oj-music-downloader: semantic multi-page HTML5, token-driven CSS design systems, PWA service workers, and Web Audio canvas visualizers.

### Kotlin, Android & Desktop Tooling — Working with
Evidenced in joshua (OJ MUSIC): 13-module Gradle build configuration, Jetpack Compose UI screens, FLAC playback pipeline, and a self-contained C + Python Windows APK installer (launcher/build_launcher.py).

### Python & Workflow Automation — Building with
Applied across cross-compiler build automation scripts, webhook orchestration, WhatsApp customer support prototypes, and early school/clinic/inventory management tools.

### Serverless APIs & Integrations — Working with
Evidenced in oj-music-downloader/yes/functions/api/download.js: Netlify serverless HTTP handlers, input sanitization, timeout control, and primary-to-fallback upstream failover.

### Applied AI Agents & Business Systems — Area of focus
Active commercial R&D focus at Apex Automation Solutions — designing domain-grounded support assistants, lead qualification flows, and operational automation for African and global SMEs.
